Context now: uptrend (rising 50-day, +30% in 20 bars); background: shakeout 1 Oct; price near resistance; two no-supply bars 16 Jul–21 Sep on volume 9% below average - no selling pressure inside an uptrend: significant (moderate significance); upthrust 23 Jul on 1.3x volume, closed on the low - but inside an uptrend with strength behind it an upthrust is 'in the wrong place', at resistance / new highs (moderate significance); three no-supply bars 24 Jul–26 Aug on volume 30% below average - but no selling pressure, but weakness in the background (low significance); upthrust 12 Aug on 0.7x volume, closed on the low - an upthrust after a serious sign of weakness: in the right place, at resistance / new highs (high significance); stopping volume 20 Aug on 1.8x volume, closed on the high - buying stops the dip, but weakness sits in the background (moderate significance); two no-demand bars 3 Sep–8 Sep on volume 68% below average - no demand in a downtrend: significant (moderate significance); last 5 bars: up bars on heavier volume (1.8x vs 0.7x) = demand in control; latest: shakeout 1 Oct on 1.7x volume, closed in the upper half - shakeouts happen when the market has been bullish: weak holders flushed (high significance); balance strength 84/100.

rs.src: RS line = FTK close ÷ SPY Massive (formerly Polygon.io) grouped-daily adjusted bars, RS cache feeds/rs/cache/grouped close on the same date (same data source as the chart bars; dates without a SPY close are skipped, never interpolated); shown in the bar tooltip. Blue dot under a price bar = RS line above its prior 251 bars (52-week RS-line high) while the close is NOT at a 252-bar closing high (RS leads price); RS-line highs together with price are listed in the tooltip only. Dots need 252 bars of RS history: judged from 2026-06-02.

rating.label: IBD-style RS (our calc, not IBD's official rating)
rating.src: feeds/rs/latest.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py: raw = 2·ROC63 + ROC126 + ROC189 + ROC252, percentile 1-99; rank 1 = strongest)

hist.rule: STRONG (bright green): rating >= 70 and d >= +3 · FIRM (dark green): rating >= 70 and -3 < d < +3 · WEAK (dark red): rating < 50 or d <= -10 · NEUTRAL (olive): everything else (rating 50-69, or 3-10 below its MA). A band switches only after the new state holds 2 sessions in a row; no band before the MA21 exists.
hist.src: RS rating history: feeds/rs/rating_history.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py; each session ranked from the Massive grouped-daily cache using only bars up to that session; only sessions with a full 252-session lookback). History for FTK starts 2026-06-08 and ends 2026-10-02; nothing is drawn before it. Orange line = 21-session simple moving average of the rating (needs 21 consecutive rated sessions).
